{{Top|leg}}
A '''percussion pistol''' was a single-shot, muzzle-loading sidearm that fired [[Fire/Legends|explosive]] projectiles. [[Exocron Airfleet]] officers were issued them as their standard sidearm. The weapons were considered to be archaic by [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].
